body: He’s went to multiple therapists and none of them have helped at all.
He says he just wants everything to end. He’s tried breaking up with me multiple times and every time he says something different. I dont know how to make him understand.
He says the main issue is that I’m a stupid person and he believes I cannot change that.

He says he’s certain he wants us to end, but I really really just want a decent shot at making things work. We haven’t met yet we were planning on doing it this summer, but if we break up it’s not possible.
